title: Notifications
description: Toasts on the 16:9 surface, with a centred 9:16 stage: stack from the top, slide in, auto-close. Messages come from the shared pool.

ratio.label: Stage ratio
ratio.help: default follows the global wall ratio. 9:16 draws the centred portrait window inside the 16:9 page; 16:9 uses the whole frame.

sound.label: Sound
sound.help: Play a tone for each newly shown notification

randomConfig.label: Random notification sources
randomConfig.help: Messages a random toast may spawn from: any matching poolId, tag or message id. Empty lists mean every notification message in the module's pools is eligible. Replaces the per-message `random` flag, which is still read from the pool but ignored.
